The purpose of this script is to determine the relationship between plant performance outcome and initial treatment conditions and fungal traits.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r, echo=FALSE,message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(patchwork)
library(emmeans)
library(Rmisc)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(car)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(lmerTest)
library(RRPP)
library(vegan)
library(cluster)
library(ggfortify)
library(viridis)
library(MuMIn)
library(corrplot)
library(regclass)

```

```{r }
harvest_data<-read.csv("Total_Harvest_Data.csv",sep=",",header=TRUE,row.names = 1)
phys_data<-read.csv("Total_Phys_Data.csv",sep=",",header=TRUE,row.names = 1)
```

#Check for correlation, normality, and homogeneity of variance
```{r}
shapiro.test(harvest_data$Height)
#normal
shapiro.test(harvest_data$Dry_Root_Mass)
hist(harvest_data$Dry_Root_Mass)
#not normal
shapiro.test(harvest_data$Total_Biomass_Data)
hist(harvest_data$Total_Biomass_Data)
#not normal
shapiro.test(harvest_data$Total_Shoot_Mass)
hist(harvest_data$Total_Shoot_Mass)
#not normal
shapiro.test(harvest_data$Ratio.of.BrownToTotal)
hist(harvest_data$Ratio.of.BrownToTotal)
#not normal
shapiro.test(harvest_data$Ratio.of.lesion.to.total.leaf)
hist(harvest_data$Ratio.of.lesion.to.total.leaf)
#not normal
shapiro.test(harvest_data$Root.Shoot)
hist(harvest_data$Root.Shoot)
#not normal
shapiro.test(phys_data$gsw)
hist(phys_data$gsw)
#not normal

#Test for homogeneity of variance 
bartlett.test(Height~Pioneer,harvest_data)
#"if non significant this concludes that there is no proof to recommend that the variance in #plant growth is different for the treatment groups"
bartlett.test(Height~Diversity.Level,harvest_data)
bartlett.test(Height~Drought,harvest_data)

bartlett.test(Ratio.of.lesion.to.total.leaf~Pioneer,harvest_data)#significant
bartlett.test(Ratio.of.lesion.to.total.leaf~Diversity.Level,harvest_data)#significant
bartlett.test(Ratio.of.lesion.to.total.leaf~Drought,harvest_data)#significant

bartlett.test(Ratio.of.BrownToTotal~Pioneer,harvest_data)
bartlett.test(Ratio.of.BrownToTotal~Diversity.Level,harvest_data)
bartlett.test(Ratio.of.BrownToTotal~Drought,harvest_data)

bartlett.test(Total_Biomass_Data~Pioneer,harvest_data)
bartlett.test(Total_Biomass_Data~Diversity.Level,harvest_data)
bartlett.test(Total_Biomass_Data~Drought,harvest_data)#significant


bartlett.test(Total_Shoot_Mass~Pioneer,harvest_data)#significant
bartlett.test(Total_Shoot_Mass~Diversity.Level,harvest_data)
bartlett.test(Total_Shoot_Mass~Drought,harvest_data)#significant

bartlett.test(Dry_Root_Mass~Pioneer,harvest_data)
bartlett.test(Dry_Root_Mass~Diversity.Level,harvest_data)#significant
bartlett.test(Dry_Root_Mass~Drought,harvest_data)

bartlett.test(Root.Shoot~Pioneer,harvest_data)
bartlett.test(Root.Shoot~Diversity.Level,harvest_data)#significant
bartlett.test(Root.Shoot~Drought,harvest_data)

#shoot mass is correlated with biomasss
harvest_data<-subset(harvest_data, Diversity.Level !="Control")
env_corr <- subset(harvest_data, select=c(TotalLeaf..,Height,BrownLeaf..,LesionLeaf,Total_Shoot_Mass,Dry_Root_Mass,Total_Biomass_Data,Root.Shoot,
         Ratio.of.lesion.to.total.leaf,Ratio.of.BrownToTotal))                               

corrplot::corrplot(cor(env_corr), method="number", type="lower", order="hclust")
allenvcor <- all_correlations(env_corr, sorted = "magnitude") #lists all pairwise correlations
```

#Transform as appropriate
```{r}
hist(harvest_data$Dry_Root_Mass)
#right skewed
hist(sqrt(harvest_data$Dry_Root_Mass))
shapiro.test(sqrt(harvest_data$Dry_Root_Mass))
#significant but W is high so good enough

hist(harvest_data$Total_Biomass_Data)
#right skewed
hist(log(harvest_data$Total_Biomass_Data))
shapiro.test(log(harvest_data$Total_Biomass_Data))
#not significant, fixed 

hist(harvest_data$Total_Shoot_Mass)
#right skewed
hist(1/(harvest_data$Total_Shoot_Mass+1))
shapiro.test(1/(harvest_data$Total_Shoot_Mass+1))
#significant but high W

hist(harvest_data$Ratio.of.BrownToTotal)
#ratio, left skewed
hist(asin(sqrt(harvest_data$Ratio.of.BrownToTotal)))
shapiro.test(asin(sqrt(harvest_data$Ratio.of.BrownToTotal)))

hist(harvest_data$Ratio.of.lesion.to.total.leaf)
#right skewed
hist(sqrt(harvest_data$Ratio.of.lesion.to.total.leaf))
shapiro.test(sqrt(harvest_data$Ratio.of.lesion.to.total.leaf))

hist(harvest_data$Root.Shoot)
#right skewed?
hist(sqrt(harvest_data$Root.Shoot))
shapiro.test((sqrt(harvest_data$Root.Shoot)))
#sig but high w
 
hist(phys_data$gsw)
#right skewed
hist(1/(phys_data$gsw+0.5))
shapiro.test(1/(phys_data$gsw+0.5))
```

#Transformed-Are any plant performance outcomes explained by treatments?
```{r}

#height remains untransformed
harvest_data$sqrtDryRootMass<-sqrt(harvest_data$Dry_Root_Mass)
harvest_data$inverseShootMass<-1/(harvest_data$Total_Shoot_Mass+1)
harvest_data$asinBrownRatio<-asin(sqrt(harvest_data$Ratio.of.BrownToTotal))
harvest_data$sqrtLesionRatio<-sqrt(harvest_data$Ratio.of.lesion.to.total.leaf)
harvest_data$sqrtRoot.Shoot<-sqrt(harvest_data$Root.Shoot)
phys_data$inversegsw<-1/(phys_data$gsw+0.5)

                        
harvest_data = harvest_data[row.names(harvest_data) %in% row.names(phys_data),]
phys_data = phys_data[row.names(phys_data) %in% row.names(harvest_data),]
phys_data$Comm<-harvest_data$Comm

Y<-cbind(harvest_data$Height,harvest_data$sqrtDryRootMass,harvest_data$inverseShootMass,harvest_data$asinBrownRatio,harvest_data$sqrtLesionRatio,harvest_data$sqrtRoot.Shoot)

man.test <- manova(Y~Comm*Drought+(1 | Microcosm)+ (1 | TimeBlock), data = harvest_data)

summary(man.test)
summary.aov(man.test)

#fungal traits test
harvest_data2<-subset(harvest_data, Diversity.Level !="Control")
harvest_data3<-subset(harvest_data2, Diversity.Level !="Mono")
harvest_dat4<-subset(harvest_data3, AverageIAA_Final !="NA")

Y<-cbind(harvest_dat4$Height,harvest_dat4$sqrtDryRootMass,harvest_dat4$inverseShootMass,harvest_dat4$asinBrownRatio,harvest_dat4$sqrtLesionRatio,harvest_dat4$sqrtRoot.Shoot)
man.test <- manova(Y~IAA_of_Comm+NASlope_of_Comm, data = harvest_dat4)

summary(man.test)
summary.aov(man.test)


man.test <- manova(Y~AverageIAA_Final+AverageNA_Final, data = harvest_dat4)

summary(man.test)
summary.aov(man.test)

persist_data<-read.csv("TraitsAndPersistence.csv",sep=",",header=TRUE,row.names = 1)

Y2=cbind(persist_data$AverageNASlope,persist_data$AverageIAA)

man.test<-manova(Y2~Persist,data=persist_data)

summary(man.test)
summary.aov(man.test)
```

## Does fungal trait distance predict plant performance?
```{r}
harvest_data3<-harvest_data[,c(30,33)]
harvest_data3<-na.omit(harvest_data3)

harvest_data= harvest_data[row.names(harvest_data) %in% row.names(harvest_data3),]

trait_vegdist<-vegan::vegdist(harvest_data3,method="euclidean")
trait_vegdist<-as.matrix(trait_vegdist)

#initial inoculation
of2 <- RRPP::lm.rrpp(trait_vegdist ~ Height+sqrtDryRootMass+inverseShootMass+asinBrownRatio+sqrtLesionRatio+sqrtRoot.Shoot ,
data = harvest_data, SS.type = "III", print.progress = FALSE, seed = "random", iter = 1000)

anova(of2, effect.type = "F")

#final community
harvest_data4<-harvest_data[,c(1,4)]
harvest_data4<-na.omit(harvest_data4)

trait_vegdist2<-vegan::vegdist(harvest_data4,method="euclidean")
trait_vegdist2<-as.matrix(trait_vegdist2)

harvest_data= harvest_data[row.names(harvest_data) %in% row.names(trait_vegdist2),]


#initial inoculation
of2 <- RRPP::lm.rrpp(trait_vegdist2 ~ Height+sqrtDryRootMass+inverseShootMass+asinBrownRatio+sqrtLesionRatio+
                       sqrtRoot.Shoot,
data = harvest_data, SS.type = "III", print.progress = FALSE, seed = "random", iter = 1000)

anova(of2, effect.type = "F")
```

#Plotting height and root mass the long way
```{r}

harvest_data<-read.csv("Total_Harvest_Data.csv",sep=",",header=TRUE,row.names = 1)

bbPalette <- c("black","#0072B2","#40a4dd","#a4cde4","darkblue")

plot<-summarySE(harvest_data,measurevar = "Height",groupvars =c("Comm","Pioneer","Phylogenetic.Treatment","Diversity.Level") ,na.rm=TRUE)

ggplot(plot,aes(Comm,Height,color=Diversity.Level))+
  geom_point(aes(x=reorder(Comm,-Height)),stat="identity",   position=position_dodge(0.8),size=5)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=Height-ci,ymax=Height+ci,width=0.5),size=1.5,position=position_dodge(0.8))+
  geom_point(data=harvest_data,stat="identity",size=3,colour="grey",alpha=0.5)+
  #geom_hline(yintercept=1,linetype="dashed", color="blue",size=1)+ 
  #geom_hline(yintercept=0.78,linetype="dashed", color="black",size=1)+
  scale_color_manual(values=bbPalette)+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 20),
        panel.grid.minor =  element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        panel.spacing = unit (0,"cm"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=1))+
  xlab("Community Treatment") +
  ylab("Height (cm)")

harvest_data$sqrtDryRootMass<-sqrt(harvest_data$Dry_Root_Mass)
plot<-summarySE(harvest_data,measurevar = "sqrtDryRootMass",groupvars =c("Comm","Pioneer","Phylogenetic.Treatment","Diversity.Level") ,na.rm=TRUE)

ggplot(plot,aes(Comm,sqrtDryRootMass,color=Diversity.Level))+
  geom_point(aes(x=reorder(Comm,-sqrtDryRootMass)),stat="identity", position=position_dodge(0.8),size=5)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=sqrtDryRootMass-ci,ymax=sqrtDryRootMass+ci,width=0.5),size=1.5,position=position_dodge(0.8))+
  geom_point(data=harvest_data,stat="identity",size=3,colour="grey",alpha=0.5)+
  #geom_hline(yintercept=1,linetype="dashed", color="blue",size=1)+ 
  #geom_hline(yintercept=0.78,linetype="dashed", color="black",size=1)+
  scale_color_manual(values=bbPalette)+
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 20),
        panel.grid.minor =  element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        panel.spacing = unit (0,"cm"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=1))+
  xlab("Community Treatment") +
  ylab("sqrt(Root Mass) (g)")

plot<-summarySE(harvest_data,measurevar = "Dry_Root_Mass",groupvars =c("Comm","Pioneer","Phylogenetic.Treatment","Diversity.Level") ,na.rm=TRUE)

ggplot(plot,aes(Comm,Dry_Root_Mass,color=Diversity.Level))+
  geom_point(aes(x=reorder(Comm,-Dry_Root_Mass)),stat="identity", position=position_dodge(0.8),size=5)+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=Dry_Root_Mass-ci,ymax=Dry_Root_Mass+ci,width=0.5),size=1.5,position=position_dodge(0.8))+
  geom_point(data=harvest_data,stat="identity",size=3,colour="grey",alpha=0.5)+
  #geom_hline(yintercept=1,linetype="dashed", color="blue",size=1)+ 
  #geom_hline(yintercept=0.78,linetype="dashed", color="black",size=1)+
  scale_color_manual(values=bbPalette)+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 20),
        panel.grid.minor =  element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        panel.spacing = unit (0,"cm"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle=90, hjust=1))+
  xlab("Community Treatment") +
  ylab("Root Mass (g)")

```

  #geom_point(aes(x=reorder(Comm,-avg)),stat="identity", position=position_dodge(1),size=5)+
  #geom_point(aes(color=Div),size=4,stat="identity",position=position_dodge(1))+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=Height-ci, ymax=Height+ci),position=position_dodge(1))+
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"))+

  theme(axis.title.y = element_text(size = rel(1.5), angle = 90)) +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = rel(1.25), angle = 0)) +
  xlab("Community") + ylab("Height (cm)") +
  #ylim(1.5,4.5)+
  scale_color_manual(labels=c("D-","D+"),values=c("lightgreen","sienna"))+
  theme_classic()+
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=0,size=15))+  
  theme(axis.text.y=element_text(angle=0,size=15))+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1))
p5
